MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 40

2. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 7
   C. 14
   D. 50

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 3
   C. 17
   D. 15

4. Solve for x: x + 8 = 17. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 8
   C. 10
   D. 9

5. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

6. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 121
   C. 22
   D. 11

7. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 5
   C. 26
   D. 25

8. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 2.5
   B. 0.25
   C. 0.205
   D. 0.025

9. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 36
   C. 81
   D. 18

10. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 82

11. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 33
   C. 32
   D. 12

12. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 27 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

13. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 72
   B. 73
   C. 17
   D. 1

14. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 24
   C. 25
   D. 2

15. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 12
   C. 32
   D. 33

16. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 7
   C. 1
   D. 12

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
